NVIDIA.row: | NVIDIA | Inkling-2-Mini UD-Q3_K_XL on an RTX 5080 16 GB (sm_120): fak-native resident CUDA decode reached 119.9 tok/s single-stream on the default path, about 1.48x upstream llama.cpp tg128 (81.0 on the same card and GGUF) and level with the fastest llama.cpp fork measured (119.5 in the same window); opt-in speculative decode (`FAK_INKLING2_SPEC=2`) reached 151.7 tok/s, +26.6% over plain decode in the same window; greedy output matches the llama.cpp oracle on 3 of 4 cases; observed 2026-11-24. | HW-witnessed ABBA, in-process decode bench, not a served-endpoint rate. Speculative decode is off by default because its batched verify is not bit-exact to the per-token step. The fourth oracle case diverges at a known near-tie, and at 1,946 tokens of context plain decode still trails the fork (89.0 vs 113.8 tok/s). [Plain decode receipt](docs/benchmarks/published/aegis-inkling2-fork-parity/RESULTS.md), [spec decode receipt](docs/benchmarks/published/aegis-inkling2-spec-decode/RESULTS.md) |
